title: The Luxor Temple back chamber, reserved for Amenhotep to connect with Amun-Ra

tellings.quote: That huge chamber in the back, as far as we know, was reserved only for Aman Hotep to connect to his father, Aman Rah, the the god.

plain: Luke Caverns, a researcher of ancient sites, talks on a podcast about Luxor Temple, a large ancient temple in Egypt. He says that a huge chamber at the back was, as far as anyone knows, reserved only for the pharaoh Amenhotep, an ancient Egyptian king, to connect with his divine father, the god Amun-Ra. For Caverns it suggests the temple was built as a place of contact with the gods.
